recommendation: Keep this no-change audit commit. Do not edit the unsystemed serviceType example for FHIR-8774 unless PA makes a new decision to constrain or replace example-bound serviceType codings.
issue_request: FHIR-8774 was Published/Persuasive for DSTU2 and asked that Appointment examples stop using participant type/code "attending" outside the required binding and use preferred-bound appointment type codes instead of the old General Discussion type code where sensible.
initial_application: The participant type issue had already been corrected by commit 976513d094, replacing local "attending" with v3 ParticipationType ATND. The explicit GF8774 application commit aea6363ec7 changed the Appointment examples from local specialty and appointment-type codes to SNOMED CT specialty 394814009 and v2-0276 appointment type codes WALKIN/FOLLOWUP; d1f387ce5e later normalized the v3 ParticipationType system URL.
additional_context: Appointment is active in source/fhir.ini and its three examples are in list-Appointment-examples.xml. The current R6 model no longer has old Appointment.type; Appointment.appointmentType remains preferred-bound to v2-0276, Appointment.serviceType is only example-bound, participant.required is boolean, and participant.type uses ATND from v3 ParticipationType.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current authoritative examples already use preferred-bound v2-0276 appointmentType codes and no longer contain invalid local participant type "attending". The remaining General Discussion serviceType coding is unsystemed and example-bound, so it is not a current required/preferred binding violation.
